newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Jan-Apr coconut exports drop 18 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Jan-Apr coconut exports drop 18 pct.

text.p: Philippine coconut products exports in the first four months of the year fell 18 percent to 451,828 tonnes, according to preliminary data on Tuesday from trade group United Coconut Associations of the Philippines Inc.
The country exported a total of 552,239 tonnes of coconut products in January to April 1996, it said in a report on Tuesday.
Preliminary data also showed coconut oil exports in the first four months of the year dropped 20 percent to 251,604 tonnes compared with 314,897 in the same period last year.
UCAP said that for April alone coconut oil exports slipped 29 percent to 69,918 tonnes as against 99,088 in April 1996.
Traders attributed the drop in Philippine coconut exports to the damage wrought by a string of typhoons in late 1995.
Coconut Oil Refiners Association president Jesus Arranza said earlier the typhoons knocked down 300,000 coconut trees and curtailed production.
Besides coconut oil, the Philippines exports copra, dessicated coconut and oleochemicals.
Philippine vegetable oil traders said they expected coconut exports to increase in the second half of the year due to prospects of better harvests.
UCAP had earlier said it expected coconut exports to inch up to 1.53 million tonnes this year from 1.50 million in 1996.
